message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-15 05:10 IST to 2026-11-16 05:10 IST (2026-11-14 23:40 UTC to 2026-11-15 23:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt only. Obvious naming variants were normalized and duplicates were merged. DLL_software_component.txt was not read or combined.

No confirmed vulnerability newly reported, materially updated, or newly surfaced within the exact 24-hour window could be tied directly to a product in the assigned primary inventory.

### Possible matches needing review

**Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field - CVE-2026-124755**

- **Affected product/component:** Justin Kruit Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field plug-in through 6.1.4
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 6.5 (CNA/NVD)
- **Description:** A stored cross-site scripting flaw can allow a low-privileged authenticated user to persist script content that executes when another user views affected content.
- **Why it may be relevant:** The inventory includes Advanced Custom Fields and WordPress, but this advisory affects a separate third-party add-on, not the Advanced Custom Fields core product. Review is needed only to determine whether this specific add-on is installed.
- **Source:** [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mcf8-pgvx-hq8r) and [Patchstack](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/advanced-custom-fields-font-awesome/vulnerability/wordpress-advanced-custom-fields-font-awesome-field-plugin-6-1-4-cross-site-scripting-xss-vulnerability)

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

The mandatory sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research.

No MongoDB finding fell inside the scan window. MongoDB's authoritative alert feed showed its newest security notices on November 13, before this run's cutoff.

**Closing:** No immediate broad review is recommended based solely on confirmed in-scope disclosures. Check whether the Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field add-on is deployed; if it is not installed, no action is indicated by this digest.
